correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the earliest attempted path edge splits into two independent subpaths, giving correct recurrences for a_n=EM_n, u_n=EU_n and c_n=E[U_n M_n] with n=1 boundary. Formal differential equations yield A=x(1-e^-2x)/(2(1-x)^2), U=xe^-x/(1-x), and the stated C. Explicit coefficient formulas and positive exponential-tail error bound B_n<=B_10<1/12 for n>=10 prove strictly negative covariance; the finite exceptions n=2,3,5 and remaining n<=9 are exact rational checks. An independently written permutation enumerator tested all (n-1)! edge-orderings for each n=2,...,8 and reproduced their stated rational covariances. This is corroboration, not an infinite sign proof.
